services.name: Bridge Program
services.desc: The Real Pilates Teacher Training Bridge Certification is a rigorous, 30-week program comprising 450 hours of academic study and practical experience. It is designed for comprehensively certified Pilates teachers who want to deepen their understanding of the Classical Pilates system. Presented through four seminar weekends and a progressive weekly schedule, the program helps experienced teachers understand the “why” behind the system, strengthen their knowledge of the complete method, and further develop their teaching and program-design skills.
